content: 1. For older adults, it is recommended to prioritize medications that carry a minimal risk of causing hypoglycemia. 2. Efforts should be made to avoid overtreatment of diabetes in older adults, as excessive treatment may lead to unnecessary complications. 3. Medications that have the potential to induce hypoglycemia should be adjusted or reconsidered if they impose additional burdens on individuals with complex health needs. 4. When formulating treatment plans, it is important to take into account the costs of care and insurance coverage to mitigate financial barriers that may hinder medication adherence.
